name: Reservation System
description: Reserve a table for a date and time, with a public view of how full each time slot is
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may read slot availability; require auth for creating, viewing, changing and cancelling reservations, and a user reaches only their own reservations; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account
A time slot is one date plus one time (HH:MM, 24-hour); every slot seats at most 20 guests in total over its active reservations

Reservation validation: name is a required non-empty string of at most 100 characters; email is required, at most 254 characters and of the form name@domain; date is YYYY-MM-DD and today or later (server date); time is a valid HH:MM; party_size is a whole number from 1 to 12; notes, when given, is at most 500 characters
Double booking: a create or replace that would put a slot above 20 guests answers 409 and changes nothing; when replacing, the reservation's own guests are not counted twice
GET /api/reservations returns the signed-in user's active reservations ordered by date and time, earliest first; ?date= keeps one day, and total counts every matching reservation
DELETE /api/reservations/:id cancels the reservation by removing it permanently, which frees its seats
GET /api/availability lists, for one day (?date=, default today), every slot that has at least one active reservation, earliest first, with booked and remaining seats
Deactivated reservations (is_active false) are left out of the user's list, answer 404 on the item endpoints and do not count against slot capacity; the admin overview still lists them
Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids, 409 for a full slot
frontend_requirements: Everyone sees a day picker with that day's booked slots and remaining seats; signed-in users also get the booking form and their own reservations, and visitors see a 'Sign in to book a table' prompt in their place
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out

Booking form: name, email, date picker, time picker, party size and optional notes; check required fields and email format before sending and show the API's message, including 'slot is full', next to the form
My reservations: grouped by date with time, party size, name and notes; reservations for today are highlighted
Each reservation has an edit action that reopens the booking form with its values and a cancel action that asks for confirmation first
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every reservation of every user, active or not, with total, active and inactive counts and the number of guests booked for today
Toggle a reservation's active status from the overview

api_endpoints.description: Book a slot for the signed-in user
The signed-in user's active reservations, earliest first
One of the signed-in user's reservations
Replace a reservation's fields (all required except notes; an omitted notes is cleared)
Cancel one of the signed-in user's reservations
Booked slots of one day with remaining seats

query.date: The day to show (YYYY-MM-DD, default today)

data_models.name: Reservation
data_models.description: A table booked by a signed-in user for one time slot

fields.user_id: integer (references the signed-in user who booked it)
fields.name: string (required, max 100 chars)
fields.date: date (YYYY-MM-DD, today or later when created or replaced)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the reservation and frees its seats)

admin_api_endpoints.description: Admin overview: every reservation with counts
